gold_comments.issue_summary:
1. `weights_only` default value changed from `False` to `True` from PyTorch 2.6, so set explicitly to `False` here, otherwise `tests/pipelines/text_to_video_synthesis/test_text_to_video_zero.py::TextToVideoZeroPipelineSlowTests::test_full_model
` will raise error
2. set `map_location` default as None which aligns w. `torch.load`, otherwise  `tests/pipelines/text_to_video_synthesis/test_text_to_video_zero.py::TextToVideoZeroPipelineSlowTests::test_full_model
` will raise error
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The diff adds `weights_only=False` to the torch.load call and changes `map_location` parameter to `Optional[str] = None`, directly matching the reviewer's two suggestions to prevent PyTorch 2.6+ compatibility errors.
gold_comments.rationale: PyTorch 2.6 changed `weights_only` default from False to True, breaking existing code that relies on the old default; explicit False preserves backward compatibility and prevents test failures.
